boundaries.label: consumer group G: one owner per partition

items: Producer keys every click by user id, so each user lives on exactly one partition
Offsets order clicks inside a partition only; offsets from different partitions are never compared
Partition count is fixed, or a routing version bump migrates the dedup identity
cards.title: Key routing

items: Each poll applies as: total += delta only when offset is newer than stored
Effect rows and the (topic, partition) checkpoint commit in ONE database transaction
A crash between apply and commit leaves nothing behind; ordered replay converges
cards.title: Atomic sink

items: The group assigns each partition to a single owner with a monotonically bumped epoch
Every commit is conditional on the caller epoch; stale owners are fenced on write
Rebalance means revoke, roll back the open txn, and resume from the committed checkpoint
